suspendConfirmOne: Suspend {name}? Flux will stop applying it. If spec.suspend is set in Git, the parent Kustomization will revert the change.
suspendConfirmMany: Suspend {n} objects? Flux will stop applying them. If spec.suspend is set in Git, the parent Kustomization will revert the change.
resumeConfirmOne: Resume {name}? Flux will reconcile it right away.
resumeConfirmMany: Resume {n} objects? Flux will reconcile them right away.

delete.prune: Prune is enabled: the managed resources will be deleted along with it ({n} in inventory).
delete.keep: Prune is disabled: the managed resources will stay in the cluster without management.
delete.helmUninstall: The Helm release will be uninstalled together with its resources.
delete.gitRecreates: If the object is defined in Git, the parent Kustomization will create it again.
delete.typeName: Type the object name "{name}" to confirm
